Message:
Btrfs: don't BUG_ON() in btrfs_truncate_inode_items()

btrfs_free_extent() can fail because of ENOMEM. There's no reason to
panic here, we can just abort the transaction.

Fixes: f4b9aa8d3b87 ("btrfs_truncate")
